spec.studio_prompt: A modern Scandinavian two-drawer nightstand crafted from natural light oak (#c8b5a8). The rectangular unit measures 45 cm wide, 40 cm deep, and 50 cm high. The top and outer side panels feature smooth, flat oak veneer with horizontal wood graining in warm sand (#d2c2b6). The front facade consists of two stacked, handle-less drawers clad in continuous, deep vertical rectangular flutes and slats (#b19b8d) with dark recessed shadow lines (#715d53), split only by a hairline horizontal drawer seam. All surfaces have a refined, low-sheen matte clear lacquer finish, resting on a low recessed plinth base.
